info.name: Get latest exchange rates (Bearer token auth)

params.name: baseCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the base currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

items.docs: Returns the latest exchange rates for all supported currencies relative to the supplied base currency. Uses Bearer token authentication via the Authorization header rather than an API key in the URL path.

info.name: Get conversion rate for a currency pair

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Your personal API key obtained from the ExchangeRate-API dashboard

params.name: baseCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the base currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

params.name: targetCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the target currency (e.g. GBP, JPY)

items.docs: Returns the conversion rate between two specific currencies. Provides a minimal JSON response focused on the pair relationship. Available on all plans.

info.name: Convert an amount between a currency pair

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Your personal API key obtained from the ExchangeRate-API dashboard

params.name: baseCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the base currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

params.name: targetCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the target currency (e.g. GBP, JPY)

params.name: amount
params.description: The amount to convert (decimal format, e.g. 1234.5678)

items.docs: Returns the conversion rate between two currencies and the result of converting the specified amount. Available on all plans.

info.name: Get historical exchange rates for a specific date

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Your personal API key obtained from the ExchangeRate-API dashboard

params.name: baseCurrency
params.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the base currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

items.docs: Returns exchange rates for all supported currencies on a specific historical date. Historical data is available back to 1990. Requires a paid subscription plan.
